2: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM "eventspaces" WHERE "capacity" = 200 AND ("event_space" ILIKE '%banquet hall%' OR "event_space" ILIKE '%conference room%');
3:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."address", r."food_service"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE LOWER('%Italian%')
  AND (LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE LOWER('%restaurant%') OR LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE LOWER('%cafe%'));
5:
SELECT DISTINCT "id", "name", "address", "food_service", "cuisine"
FROM "restaurants"
WHERE ("food_service" ILIKE '%restaurant%' OR "food_service" ILIKE '%cafe%')
  AND "cuisine" ILIKE '%italian%';
6:
SELECT "name", "role", "language"
FROM "staff"
WHERE "role" ILIKE '%chef%'
UNION ALL
SELECT "name", "role", "language"
FROM "staff"
WHERE "role" ILIKE '%server%' AND "language" ILIKE '%english%';
7:
SELECT s.*
FROM "staff" s
WHERE (s."role" ILIKE '%chef%' OR s."role" ILIKE '%server%')
  AND s."language" ILIKE '%English%';
8:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT "name",
    "role",
    "language"
                FROM "staff"
WHERE
    ("role" ILIKE '%chef%' AND "language" ILIKE '%English%')
    OR
    ("role" ILIKE '%server%' AND "language" ILIKE '%English%')
            ) sub
            ORDER BY "role" ;
110:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT sp."name" AS "Специалист", s."system_name" AS "Система", s."is_active" AS "Активна"
                FROM "it_support_specialists" sp
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" iss ON sp."id" = iss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" s ON iss."system_id" = s."system_id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY sp."name", s."system_name" ;
111:
SELECT 
    iss."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_name",
    s."is_active"
FROM "it_support_specialists" iss
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" iss_sys ON iss."id" = iss_sys."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" s ON iss_sys."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY iss."name", s."system_name";
112:
SELECT DISTINCT r."responsibility"
FROM "responsibilities" r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM "internships" i
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "internships_responsibilities" ir
        WHERE ir."internshipid" = i."id"
          AND ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
    )
);
114:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT s."name",
    sys."system_name"
                FROM "it_support_specialists" s
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" ss ON s."id" = ss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" sys ON ss."system_id" = sys."system_id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY s."name", sys."system_name" ;
115:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT i."title" AS internship_title, r."responsibility" AS responsibility
                FROM "internships" i
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY i."title", r."responsibility" ;
261:
SELECT
    "j"."minimum_years",
    "j"."preferred_years"
FROM "jobs" AS "j"
ORDER BY "j"."salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
264:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p."title" AS "Job Position",
    s."salary_range" AS "Salary Range"
FROM "position" p
LEFT JOIN "salarydetails" s ON p."id" = s."positionid";
